content.title: Final weeks as all 1,995 Target’s stores get green light to close down for 24-hours
content.text: TARGET will briefly close all of its stores for an entire day, and shoppers will have to look elsewhere. The retailer is shutting down for Easter Sunday, April 5, so shoppers need to act fast to avoid delays. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! Target will close its doors for Easter Sunday Credit: Bloomberg via Getty Images Target closes for several federal holidays throughout the year, including Memorial Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s Day. Shoppers will not be able to access Target stores at all on April 5, so they should get to their local spot before it’s too late. Target‘s website will still be taking orders, but any placed on Easter Sunday will not be processed until the following day. Several other retailers will close on Easter Sunday. This includes Hobby Lobby, Kohl’s, Costco, Aldi and Lowe’s. Fast food chains, including In-N-Out, will also close for the federal holiday on April 5. Retailers closed for Easter Sunday 2026 1. Inputting your address into these tools allows you to see the specific opening hours of stores in your area. Most read in Money Vital services will also be paused on Easter Sunday, such as the United States Postal Service (USPS). On Easter Sunday, Priority Mail Express services will work, and customers will be able to access the USPS website. Services are expected to return to normal the day after.
